name: Damage/Destruction of the satellite via the use of ASAT
description: Deliberate physical damage to the satellite or some of its segments. This threat can negatively impact any aspect of satellite operations, epending on the specific satellite asset that has been damaged. hysical damage to the satellite can be caused by a deliberate attack ia an ASAT weapon. ASAT includes space or ground based directed nergy weapons or kinetic weapons inteded to physically destroy atellites, namely: high-powered microwave (HPM) weapons, lectromagnetic pulse (EMP), high-powered laser weapons, laser dazzling and blinding, and high-altitude nuclear detonation. This also entails proximity operations where rogue space objects approach space assets for the purpose of assessing their capabilities (spying), making physical contact (ramming), or conducting aforementioned attacks.
